senses.en: Coming after the eleventh in a sequence.
One of twelve equal parts of something.

ex.en: We celebrated her twelfth birthday with a homemade cake.
By the twelfth month of the programme, most participants had developed more effective study habits.

col: twelfth birthday｜sinh nhật lần thứ mười hai
the twelfth century｜thế kỷ thứ mười hai
one twelfth of｜một phần mười hai của
tip: Số thứ tự của twelve là twelfth: chú ý ve đổi thành f.

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes
a long area with a particular feature
a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects

ex.en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.

col: fasten a belt｜thắt dây an toàn/thắt lưng
green belt｜vành đai xanh (quanh thành phố)
tip: Ngoài nghĩa thắt lưng, belt còn chỉ khu vực dạng dải, như green belt.

senses.en: A man whose job is to put out fires.

ex.en: The fireman rescued a kitten from the smoky kitchen.
The fireman explained that regular safety inspections could prevent many accidents in residential buildings.

col: a brave fireman｜một lính cứu hỏa dũng cảm
a fireman's helmet｜mũ bảo hiểm của lính cứu hỏa
a volunteer fireman｜lính cứu hỏa tình nguyện
tip: Số nhiều là firemen; cách nói trung tính hiện đại hơn là firefighter.

senses.zh: buổi phỏng vấn (tuyển dụng); cuộc gặp trao đổi
senses.en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position

senses.zh: cuộc phỏng vấn (báo chí); cuộc trò chuyện nghiên cứu
senses.en: a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research
to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research

ex.en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.

col: conduct an interview｜tiến hành phỏng vấn
an in-depth interview｜cuộc phỏng vấn chuyên sâu
tip: interviewer là người đặt câu hỏi; interviewee là người được phỏng vấn.

senses.en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.

col: similar characteristics｜các đặc điểm tương tự
tip: Dùng similar to, không dùng similar with; similar không có nghĩa là identical.

senses.en: Complete, with no part missing or left out.
A complete thing made up of connected parts.

ex.en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.

col: as a whole｜nói chung; như một tổng thể
a whole range of｜hàng loạt; đủ loại
tip: Chú ý trật tự từ: the whole day nghĩa là all the day (cả ngày).

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind

senses.zh: sự suy nghĩ; sự cân nhắc
senses.en: the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.

col: give something some thought｜cân nhắc điều gì
deep in thought｜chìm trong suy tư
a sudden thought｜một ý nghĩ chợt đến
food for thought｜điều đáng suy ngẫm
tip: Khi chỉ một ý nghĩ cụ thể thì đếm được; khi chỉ quá trình suy nghĩ thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: With a sound that has high volume.

ex.en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.

tip: loudly nhấn mạnh âm lượng lớn; aloud nhấn mạnh việc phát ra tiếng thay vì đọc thầm.

senses.en: How heavy someone or something is.
A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight.

senses.zh: tầm quan trọng; sức ảnh hưởng
senses.en: The importance or influence given to something.

ex.en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.

tip: weight là danh từ; weigh là động từ: How much does it weigh?

senses.zh: bìa hồ sơ; tập đựng giấy
senses.en: A folded cover used to hold loose papers.
A place on a computer where files are grouped together.

ex.en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.

col: a shared folder｜thư mục dùng chung
save files in a folder｜lưu tệp vào thư mục
tip: file là tệp; folder là thư mục chứa các tệp.

senses.en: to take something without permission and keep or use it
to move quietly without attracting attention
something bought for much less than its usual price

ex.en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.

col: steal from someone｜lấy trộm của ai
steal an idea｜đánh cắp ý tưởng
steal the show｜chiếm hết sự chú ý
tip: Quá khứ là stole, quá khứ phân từ là stolen; tân ngữ thường là đồ vật.

senses.zh: hiện đại; thuộc thời cận đại
senses.en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times.
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.

tip: modern nhấn mạnh tính hiện đại hoặc kiểu mới; không nhất thiết là vừa mới được làm ra.

senses.en: a belief or judgement about someone or something

ex.en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.

col: express an opinion｜bày tỏ ý kiến
a difference of opinion｜sự bất đồng ý kiến
tip: Để nói “theo tôi” dùng in my opinion, không dùng according to me.

senses.en: Someone receiving medical care.
Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.

ex.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.

col: treat a patient｜điều trị bệnh nhân
tip: Là danh từ thì nghĩa là “bệnh nhân”; là tính từ thường đi với with.

senses.en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.

tip: robot là danh từ đếm được; robotics chỉ ngành rô-bốt học.

senses.en: the father of your husband or wife

ex.en: My father-in-law helped us repair the garden fence.
Living with a father-in-law may encourage families to share household expenses and provide care across generations.

col: future father-in-law｜bố chồng/bố vợ tương lai
elderly father-in-law｜bố chồng/bố vợ lớn tuổi
tip: Không phải bố dượng; bố dượng là stepfather.

senses.zh: người lãnh đạo; người dẫn dắt
senses.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.
A person or organization ahead of others in a field.

ex.en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.

col: political leader｜nhà lãnh đạo chính trị
market leader｜doanh nghiệp dẫn đầu thị trường
tip: leader chỉ người lãnh đạo; leadership chỉ khả năng lãnh đạo hoặc ban lãnh đạo.

senses.en: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground.
A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.

ex.en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.

col: take the subway｜đi tàu điện ngầm
pedestrian subway｜đường hầm dành cho người đi bộ
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Mỹ là tàu điện ngầm; trong tiếng Anh Anh thường chỉ đường hầm cho người đi bộ.

senses.en: feeling happy or satisfied about something

ex.en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.

col: pleased to meet you｜rất vui được gặp bạn
tip: Hài lòng với kết quả dùng pleased with; nghe tin vui dùng pleased to hear.

senses.en: Most important or largest among others.

senses.zh: ống dẫn chính; đường dây chính
senses.en: A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.

ex.en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.

tip: Tính từ main thường đứng trước danh từ; trạng từ “chủ yếu” là mainly.

senses.zh: hiệu thuốc (bán cả đồ dùng hằng ngày)
senses.en: an American shop selling medicines and various everyday products

ex.en: I bought some toothpaste at the drugstore near the station.
In some communities, the local drugstore provides essential health advice as well as affordable medicines.

tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng chemist’s hoặc pharmacy.

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.

col: several of them｜vài người trong số họ
for several reasons｜vì nhiều lý do
tip: Theo sau là danh từ đếm được số nhiều; several of đi với từ hạn định hoặc đại từ.

senses.zh: thợ cắt tóc; thợ làm tóc
senses.en: someone whose job is to cut and style hair

ex.en: The hairdresser trimmed my hair and dried it gently.
Training as a hairdresser combines practical skills with customer service, offering a career path outside traditional academic education.

col: qualified hairdresser｜thợ làm tóc có tay nghề
go to the hairdresser's｜đi tiệm cắt tóc
tip: hairdresser chỉ người; the hairdresser's thường chỉ tiệm cắt tóc.

senses.en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.

ex.en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.

col: customer satisfaction｜mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng
customer loyalty｜lòng trung thành của khách hàng
tip: customer là khách hàng nói chung; client thường chỉ khách hàng của dịch vụ chuyên môn.

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.

tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, collect someone có thể nghĩa là đi đón ai.

senses.en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.

tip: Danh từ đếm được, số nhiều là frogs; toad là con cóc.

senses.en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it.

senses.zh: sức hấp dẫn; điều kỳ diệu
senses.en: A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful.

senses.zh: có phép thuật; thuộc ảo thuật
senses.en: Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.

ex.en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.

tip: magic thường chỉ phép thuật hoặc ảo thuật; magical còn dùng để tả trải nghiệm tuyệt vời.

senses.en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study

ex.en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.

col: a topic of discussion｜chủ đề thảo luận
a controversial topic｜chủ đề gây tranh cãi
tip: topic là chủ đề thảo luận hoặc viết; title là tiêu đề của bài viết, v.v.

senses.en: very unpleasant or bad
causing strong fear or shock

ex.en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.

col: a horrible experience｜một trải nghiệm tồi tệ
tip: horrible thường chỉ điều rất tệ; horrific thường chỉ điều ghê rợn, thảm khốc.

senses.en: added to the usual or necessary amount
more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount

senses.zh: khoản phụ; diễn viên quần chúng
senses.en: an additional item, or a background actor in a film

ex.en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.

tip: Là tính từ thì nghĩa là “thêm”; trong pay extra thì extra là trạng từ.

senses.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.
Touching or supported by a surface.
For protection from something harmful or unwanted.

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.

col: protect against｜bảo vệ khỏi; phòng chống
tip: against là giới từ, theo sau là danh từ, đại từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.

ex.en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.

col: smartphone app｜ứng dụng điện thoại thông minh
smartphone user｜người dùng điện thoại thông minh
smartphone addiction｜nghiện điện thoại thông minh
tip: smartphone là danh từ đếm được, thường viết liền thành một từ.

senses.en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error.

senses.zh: đòi hỏi; bắt buộc phải trả
senses.en: Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.

ex.en: Can you tell me the exact time we should arrive?
Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.

col: exact a heavy toll｜gây ra tổn thất nặng nề
tip: exact nhấn mạnh sự không sai một li; trạng từ là exactly.

senses.en: A paper copy of a document made using a machine.
To make a paper copy of a document using a machine.

ex.en: Please bring a photocopy of your passport tomorrow.
Students should keep a photocopy of important application documents in case the originals are lost.

col: a photocopy of a document｜bản photo của tài liệu
photocopy a form｜photo một mẫu đơn
tip: Vừa là danh từ vừa là động từ; số nhiều và ngôi thứ ba số ít đều là photocopies.

senses.en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.

ex.en: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.

tip: Chỉ hoạt động hút thuốc thì không đếm được; “bỏ thuốc” có thể nói give up smoking.

senses.en: An informal word for a man.

ex.en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.

col: a nice guy｜một anh chàng tốt bụng
a young guy｜một chàng trai trẻ
a regular guy｜một người bình thường
tip: guy là từ thân mật; trong văn viết trang trọng thường dùng man hoặc person.

senses.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.

col: compare A with B｜so sánh A với B
compare A to B｜ví A như B; so sánh A với B
compare favourably with｜sánh được với; không thua kém
tip: So sánh có thể dùng with hoặc to; khi mang nghĩa ví von thì thường dùng to.

senses.en: Having a particular colour or colours rather than being plain.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the coloured glass onto the floor.
Teachers can use coloured blocks to help young children recognise patterns and develop basic mathematical skills.

col: brightly coloured｜có màu sắc rực rỡ
tip: Anh Anh viết coloured, Anh Mỹ viết colored; tránh dùng để chỉ nhóm người.
note: Dùng để chỉ người da màu nói chung thường lỗi thời và xúc phạm; ở một số nơi có cách dùng mang nghĩa bản sắc riêng.

senses.en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.

ex.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.

col: unpack a suitcase｜dỡ đồ khỏi va-li
a wheeled suitcase｜va-li có bánh xe
tip: suitcase đếm được; luggage là từ chỉ hành lý nói chung và không đếm được.

senses.en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface

ex.en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.

col: put up a poster｜dán áp phích
design a poster｜thiết kế áp phích
tip: poster là áp phích; postcard là bưu thiếp, cần phân biệt.

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.

col: a gift for languages｜năng khiếu ngôn ngữ
tip: Khi chỉ năng khiếu thường dùng a gift for, theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.zh: áo sơ mi nữ; áo kiểu nữ
senses.en: A shirt traditionally worn by women, often made from light fabric

ex.en: She wore a blue blouse with her favourite grey trousers.
Choosing a durable blouse rather than a cheaply made alternative may reduce clothing waste over time.

col: silk blouse｜áo sơ mi lụa nữ
long-sleeved blouse｜áo sơ mi nữ dài tay
loose-fitting blouse｜áo sơ mi nữ rộng
tip: Thường chỉ áo sơ mi nữ; shirt có phạm vi dùng rộng hơn.

senses.zh: chi tiết; thông tin cụ thể
senses.en: a small fact or feature of something
the amount of specific information provided

senses.zh: nêu chi tiết; trình bày tỉ mỉ
senses.en: to describe something fully, including specific facts

ex.en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.

col: pay attention to detail｜chú ý đến chi tiết
further details｜thông tin cụ thể hơn
tip: in detail không dùng số nhiều; thông tin liên hệ là contact details.

senses.en: Used when something is possible but not certain.

senses.zh: có lẽ (gợi ý hoặc đề nghị nhẹ nhàng)
senses.en: Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.

ex.en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.

col: perhaps the best｜có lẽ là tốt nhất
perhaps we could｜có lẽ chúng ta có thể
tip: perhaps trang trọng hơn maybe một chút; đặt đầu câu để lời gợi ý nhẹ nhàng hơn.

senses.en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold

ex.en: The bakery near our house sells warm bread every morning.
Small businesses such as bakeries provide local employment and help maintain vibrant neighbourhood shopping areas.

tip: bakery chỉ cửa hàng hoặc nơi làm bánh; đồ nướng nói chung là baked goods.

senses.zh: phục vụ (món ăn); cung cấp; tiếp khách
senses.en: To give food or drink, or assist customers.
To work for people, an organisation, or your country.
To be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.

col: serve the community｜phục vụ cộng đồng
serve as｜dùng làm; đóng vai trò
tip: serve as đi với vai trò hoặc công dụng; không dùng serve for theo cách này.

senses.en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another

ex.en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.

tip: Anh Anh viết neighbour, Anh Mỹ viết neighbor.

senses.en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen
a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen
to suddenly become clear or understood

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.

col: click on a link｜nhấp vào liên kết
a mouse click｜một cú nhấp chuột
a sharp click｜tiếng lách cách sắc gọn
tip: Nhấp vào liên kết dùng click on; it clicked có thể nghĩa là chợt hiểu ra.

senses.en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise.
A period of slow, steady running.
To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.

ex.en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.

col: go for a jog｜đi chạy bộ
jog along｜chạy bộ chậm dọc theo
jog someone's memory｜gợi lại trí nhớ của ai
tip: jog someone's memory nghĩa là “gợi lại trí nhớ của ai”.

senses.en: the smallest amount of something

senses.zh: ít nhất; ở mức thấp nhất
senses.en: to the smallest degree or extent

senses.zh: lượng ít nhất; mức thấp nhất
senses.en: the smallest amount or degree

ex.en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.

col: least of all｜càng không; nhất là không
tip: least là dạng so sánh nhất của little; với danh từ đếm được dùng fewest.

senses.en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves
To cook or heat food in a microwave oven
A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication

ex.en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.

col: microwave food｜hâm nóng thức ăn bằng lò vi sóng
tip: Khi là động từ có thể đi thẳng với tân ngữ chỉ đồ ăn: microwave the soup.

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.

tip: Số nhiều là butterflies; nghĩa “bơi bướm” thường không đếm được.

senses.en: relating to Canada, its people, or its culture
a person from Canada

ex.en: Our Canadian neighbour invited us over for dinner yesterday.
Canadian cities face challenges in providing affordable housing while accommodating population growth and protecting green spaces.

tip: Từ chỉ quốc tịch viết hoa chữ cái đầu; danh từ số nhiều là Canadians.

senses.en: words expressing pleasure at someone's success or good fortune
said to show happiness about someone's achievement or good news

ex.en: Congratulations on passing your driving test this morning!
The research team received congratulations from colleagues after winning an international award for environmental innovation.

col: congratulations on your success｜chúc mừng thành công của bạn
warm congratulations｜lời chúc mừng nồng nhiệt
tip: Lời chúc mừng thường dùng ở số nhiều; congratulations on theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level
to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it

senses.zh: tầm với; phạm vi ảnh hưởng
senses.en: the distance or extent over which something can act

ex.en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.

col: reach a destination｜đến nơi cần đến
reach an agreement｜đạt được thỏa thuận
reach for something｜với tay lấy cái gì
tip: Khi nghĩa là “đến”, reach đi thẳng với địa điểm: reach the station, không thêm at.

senses.en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders
a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle

ex.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.

col: the neck of a bottle｜cổ chai
tip: neck là cái cổ; throat là cổ họng, đừng nhầm lẫn.

senses.en: An area or building where cars can be parked.

ex.en: We found a space in the station car park.
Replacing an underused car park with green space could improve the quality of life for nearby residents.

col: multi-storey car park｜bãi đỗ xe nhiều tầng
underground car park｜bãi đỗ xe ngầm
car park entrance｜lối vào bãi đỗ xe
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng car park; tiếng Anh Mỹ gọi bãi đỗ xe ngoài trời là parking lot.
note: Chuẩn hóa chính tả: danh từ này thường viết là car park, không có dấu gạch nối.

senses.en: A device that produces light, often on a table.

ex.en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.

tip: lamp là thiết bị đèn; light còn có thể chỉ ánh sáng.

senses.en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.

ex.en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.

col: a bunch of grapes｜một chùm nho
tip: Một quả nho là a grape, một chùm là a bunch of grapes.

senses.en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food
to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly
to turn a camera slowly across a scene

ex.en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
Television chefs can encourage healthier eating by demonstrating how to prepare nutritious meals using a single pan.

col: be panned by critics｜bị các nhà phê bình chê thậm tệ
pan across a scene｜quay lia máy qua cả cảnh
tip: Khi là động từ, quá khứ là panned, hiện tại phân từ là panning.

senses.en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface
one action in a process or towards a goal
to move by lifting and placing your foot

ex.en: Take one step forward and close the door.
Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.

col: take a step｜bước một bước; thực hiện một biện pháp
take steps to｜thực hiện các biện pháp để
tip: take steps to do sth nghĩa là “thực hiện các biện pháp để làm gì”.

senses.en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.

col: a foggy morning｜một buổi sáng sương mù
foggy conditions｜điều kiện sương mù dày đặc
tip: foggy có thể tả thời tiết, cũng có thể tả trí nhớ mơ hồ.

senses.en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity

senses.zh: tăng gấp đôi; làm gấp đôi
senses.en: become twice as much, or make something twice as much
an amount that is twice as large as another

ex.en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.

col: double the amount｜gấp đôi số lượng
double in size｜tăng gấp đôi về kích thước
tip: double nghĩa là trở thành gấp hai lần ban đầu, tức tăng thêm 100%.

senses.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

ex.en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.

tip: carpet thường chỉ thảm phủ diện tích lớn; rug là tấm thảm nhỏ có thể di chuyển.

senses.zh: một trong hai người sinh đôi
senses.en: One of two children born to the same mother together.
Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.

ex.en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.

col: identical twins｜cặp song sinh cùng trứng
tip: a twin là một người trong cặp sinh đôi; twins là cả hai người.

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.

col: read through｜đọc từ đầu đến cuối
tip: through nhấn mạnh đi xuyên bên trong; across nhấn mạnh băng ngang trên bề mặt.

senses.zh: thiết bị; dụng cụ; trang bị
senses.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.

col: a piece of equipment｜một thiết bị
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; muốn nói một thiết bị dùng a piece of equipment.

senses.zh: rắc rối; khó khăn; sự cố
senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.

col: have trouble doing something｜gặp khó khăn khi làm việc gì
take the trouble to do something｜chịu khó làm việc gì
tip: Để nói “gặp khó khăn khi làm gì” dùng have trouble doing.

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things together
to join things together using glue

ex.en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.

col: be glued to a screen｜dán mắt vào màn hình
tip: Khi là danh từ thường không đếm được; be glued to có thể nghĩa là dán mắt vào.

senses.en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way.
To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.

ex.en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.

col: argue with someone｜tranh cãi với ai
argue about something｜tranh cãi về điều gì
tip: argue that thường dùng trong văn nghị luận, để nêu một quan điểm có lý lẽ.

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.

col: safe and sound｜bình an vô sự
safe drinking water｜nước uống an toàn
a safe investment｜khoản đầu tư an toàn
keep someone safe｜giữ ai được an toàn
tip: safe là tính từ, safety là danh từ: chú ý phân biệt từ loại.

senses.en: having a pleasant flavour

ex.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.

tip: tasty chỉ đồ ăn ngon; tasteful chỉ sự có gu thẩm mỹ.

senses.en: The way a person or animal acts.
The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.

ex.en: The puppy's calm behaviour surprised everyone at the park.
Schools can encourage positive behaviour by establishing clear expectations and recognising students' efforts to cooperate.

col: consumer behaviour｜hành vi người tiêu dùng
animal behaviour｜hành vi của động vật
tip: Thường không đếm được; Anh Anh viết behaviour, Anh Mỹ viết behavior.

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.

col: stamp a passport｜đóng dấu vào hộ chiếu
tip: Con tem là a stamp; “dán tem lên phong bì” dùng put a stamp on.

senses.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

ex.en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.

col: unfortunately for someone｜không may cho ai
tip: Thường đặt đầu câu, theo sau là dấu phẩy, để bày tỏ sự tiếc nuối về cả sự việc.

senses.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

ex.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.

col: the usual routine｜thói quen thường ngày
tip: as usual nghĩa là “như mọi khi”; than usual nghĩa là “hơn bình thường”.

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.

senses.zh: tính hệ thống; sự có phương pháp
senses.en: An organized and systematic approach to an activity.

ex.en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.

col: method of payment｜phương thức thanh toán
tip: Thường dùng a method of/for doing sth để nói cách làm việc gì.

senses.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.

tip: Diện tích dùng square metres; chiều dài dùng metres, đừng nhầm.

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.

col: at the bottom of｜ở đáy của
bottom shelf｜ngăn dưới cùng của kệ
from top to bottom｜từ trên xuống dưới
tip: Ở đáy của vật gì thì dùng at the bottom of.

senses.en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail

ex.en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.

col: crocodile habitat｜môi trường sống của cá sấu
crocodile tears｜nước mắt cá sấu; sự thương xót giả tạo
tip: alligator là cá sấu mõm ngắn (cá sấu Mỹ), không phải cùng loài với crocodile.

senses.en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval.

senses.zh: tiếng vỗ tay; tiếng nổ giòn
senses.en: A sudden loud sound, especially from hands striking together.

ex.en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.

col: a clap of thunder｜một tiếng sấm
tip: Quá khứ là clapped; hiện tại phân từ là clapping, gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.

tip: Nói at noon, không nói in noon; giữa trưa là 12 p.m.

senses.zh: cuộc thảo luận; sự bàn bạc
senses.en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject.

senses.zh: bài luận bàn; sự bàn luận
senses.en: A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.

ex.en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.

tip: Danh từ discussion đi với about hoặc of; động từ discuss theo sau trực tiếp là chủ đề.

senses.en: A ceremony in which two people get married.

ex.en: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.

tip: wedding là lễ cưới; marriage là quan hệ hôn nhân.

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body

senses.zh: quan hệ huyết thống; dòng dõi
senses.en: family relationships or origins

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.

tip: blood thường không đếm được; một lần xét nghiệm máu là a blood test.

senses.en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.

ex.en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.

tip: wallet thường chỉ loại ví gấp để đựng tiền giấy và thẻ.

senses.en: As stated or reported by someone or something
In a way determined by a rule or particular factor

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.

tip: Thường dùng cụm according to, không dùng according riêng như một tính từ.

senses.en: a game of rolling a heavy ball to knock down pins
the action of delivering the ball towards a cricket batter

ex.en: My cousins and I went bowling on Saturday.
Leisure centres offering activities such as bowling can encourage social interaction among people of different ages.

tip: Chơi bowling dùng go bowling; từ này còn chỉ cú ném bóng trong môn cricket.

senses.en: A large group of people gathered in one place.
To gather closely together or fill a place with people.

ex.en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.

col: a large crowd｜một đám đông lớn
attract a crowd｜thu hút đám đông
tip: a crowd of đi với danh từ số nhiều; crowded nghĩa là đông đúc.

senses.en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food

ex.en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.

col: preheat the oven｜làm nóng lò nướng trước
bake in the oven｜nướng trong lò
tip: oven là lò nướng kín; bếp nấu phía trên thường gọi là hob hoặc stove.

senses.en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect.
More badly or severely than anyone or anything else.

senses.zh: tình huống tệ nhất; phần tệ nhất
senses.en: The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.

ex.en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.

col: the worst possible outcome｜kết quả xấu nhất có thể xảy ra
at worst｜trong trường hợp xấu nhất
prepare for the worst｜chuẩn bị cho tình huống xấu nhất
worst affected｜bị ảnh hưởng nặng nhất
tip: worst là dạng so sánh nhất của bad và badly; dạng so sánh hơn là worse.

senses.en: with little or no noise
without attracting attention or making something widely known

ex.en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.

col: quietly confident｜tự tin một cách kín đáo
tip: quietly là trạng từ; đừng nhầm với quite (khá).

senses.en: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.

col: a cute baby｜một em bé dễ thương
a cute smile｜nụ cười dễ thương
tip: Mang tính khẩu ngữ, thường dùng cho em bé, thú nhỏ hoặc vẻ ngoài đáng yêu.

senses.en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills
a comfortable bus used for longer journeys
to train or teach someone to improve particular skills

ex.en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.

col: sports coach｜huấn luyện viên thể thao
travel by coach｜đi bằng xe khách
coach a team｜huấn luyện một đội
coach someone for an exam｜kèm ai ôn thi
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, coach còn nghĩa là xe khách đường dài, còn bus thường chỉ xe buýt.

senses.en: a machine that produces power to make something move
something that strongly drives growth or change
software that performs a particular core task within a system

ex.en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.

col: start the engine｜khởi động động cơ
an engine of growth｜động lực tăng trưởng
tip: engine thường chỉ động cơ đốt nhiên liệu; động cơ điện thường dùng motor.

senses.en: an official rule, or the system of such rules
the study or profession concerned with legal rules
a general scientific rule describing how something always behaves

ex.en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.

col: break the law｜vi phạm pháp luật
the laws of physics｜các định luật vật lý
tip: Một đạo luật cụ thể thì đếm được; ngành luật dùng law không đếm được.

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.

col: pay a bill｜thanh toán hóa đơn
pass a bill｜thông qua dự luật
a dollar bill｜tờ một đô la
tip: bill là dự luật đang được xem xét; chỉ khi được thông qua và có hiệu lực mới thành luật.

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: should do something｜nên làm việc gì
should have done｜lẽ ra đã phải làm
should be able to｜hẳn có thể
tip: Là động từ khuyết thiếu, theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu; should have done thường chỉ việc lẽ ra nên làm mà chưa làm.

senses.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.

senses.zh: môi trường sống hoặc làm việc
senses.en: The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.

col: protect the environment｜bảo vệ môi trường
tip: Khi nói chung về môi trường tự nhiên thường dùng the environment.

senses.en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose

senses.zh: hoàn thiện; làm cho thành thạo
senses.en: to improve something until it is as good as possible
describing verb forms using have with a past participle

ex.en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.

col: perfect a technique｜hoàn thiện một kỹ thuật
present perfect｜thì hiện tại hoàn thành
tip: Tính từ nhấn âm đầu; động từ nhấn âm hai: /pəˈfekt/ (Anh).
